limitations: Only two test speakers; useful as a canonical comparison cohort, not a demographic-generalization claim.
Noisy signals are prepared mixtures using real noise recordings, not real-room re-recordings.
The current benchmark runtime does not score this cohort; this is dataset registration and acquisition evidence only.
Audio bytes are fetched from the official DataShare record and excluded from Git.
purpose: standard paired speech-enhancement test cohort; recorded clean speech with noisy mixtures made using recorded environmental noise
